Rajiv / Diego —

I’m copying finance (Laura) and my manager (Marissa) so we can propose a clean set of options. High level from sales side: we have seen procurement teams accept either (A) single sweep with an invoice split and a note documenting VAT responsibilities, or (B) a staggered settlement where 60% is paid at sweep and remaining 40% after 30 days (or tied to usage confirmation).

From our side, staggered is fine but requires:
- A signed MOU that lists PO numbers, amounts attributed to each PO, and the dates for each payment tranche;
- Confirmation of VAT handling (gross vs net) and any WHT (withholding) obligations per jurisdiction;
- A single clearing date we can schedule for the sweep if HelioHome chooses the single‑sweep route.

Laura — can you outline the documentation we’ll need and whether Redwood can issue region‑split invoices (one per PO) or whether finance prefers one invoice with allocation notes?

Thanks — Vivek

Hi Rajiv / team —

Apologies for the short delay. Below are two operational proposals from Redwood Finance and the documentation required for each. I’ve attached a short VAT evidence checklist to speed the handoff (Redwood_VAT-evidence-checklist.xlsx).

Option A — Single sweep (preferred timing 2026‑12‑01):
- Redwood issues a single consolidated invoice for the contract true‑up.
- We will include a line‑by‑line allocation appendix mapping invoice lines to the PO numbers you provide.
- VAT treatment: Redwood will invoice net of VAT where you provide valid VAT registration numbers / proof of business (EU) OR we can gross up and include VAT if you prefer. Evidence needed: VAT registration numbers + signed customer confirmation for non‑taxable cross‑border sale.
- Payment terms: Net 7 on the sweep date.

Option B — Staggered sweep (two tranches):
- Tranche 1 (60%) scheduled 2026‑12‑01; Tranche 2 (40%) scheduled 2026‑12‑31 or upon usage confirmation.
- Redwood will issue two invoices or one invoice with a credit memo for the second tranche — whichever your AP system prefers.
- VAT: same evidence required; note that staggered timing can complicate VAT reclaim windows — please confirm with your tax advisors.

Additional items / notes:
- Withholding tax (WHT): if HelioHome is required to withhold, please send the local tax form and expected withholding percentage so we can issue grossed‑up numbers if needed.
- Required attachments from HelioHome: completed PO list (one per row with amount), VAT registration documentation for EEA entities, WHT certificate if applicable, and the signatory name for the MOU.

We can prepare the MOU and a DocuSign packet once we have the PO list. I’ll also prepare line‑level allocation templates so your AP team can ingest them directly.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
